GAH Transport Refrigeration
We design, manufacture and maintain refrigeration systems for vans and 3.5 to 18 tonne chassis cabs for any size of company whether that is for a single refrigerated van or a fleet of vehicles.
Our systems carry temperature sensitive goods for chill, freeze and even heat applications in single or multi-compartment, suitably insulated vehicles.
All our systems are designed using the latest 3D CAD systems and manufactured in-house to deliver pioneering transport refrigeration solutions to meet the ever-changing requirements of cold chain distribution.

Why Choose GAH
With twenty five years experience, GAH are committed to supplying powerful, yet fuel efficient solutions that meet the challenges facing the transport industry and delivering a variety of temperature sensitive products at the right temperature with minimal impact on the environment.
We benefit from working closely with the design team who have produced specific units for Ocado.
They always deliver and install the units on time even though our requirements change quite quickly at times!
Once installed the units operate exactly as they should.
The proof is that we operate over 1,500 vans and, when the sun is shining, we never worry about fridge temperatures.
Maintenance on site is always on time and, in the event of a breakdown, the engineers arrive on site, on time and fix it first time.
We have no issues with GAH.
The GAH engineers are well trained and arrive on our sites well equipped, in well stocked vans at the times we need them.
I find the office staff and engineers to be friendly, polite and eager to help. The team always have a helpful approach at resolving any enquiry. Updates, technical information, advice or support where needed, is provided in an efficient and timely fashion whether that is face to face, by phone or email.
Who We Work With
From supermarkets' home delivery vehicles, cold chain distribution fleets and local independent food suppliers to transporting pharmaceuticals and fine art, GAH Refrigeration have the best solution for your transport refrigeration requirements.

Built In Britain
About GAH Transport Refrigeration
We design, manufacture and maintain transport refrigeration systems to fit any size of vehicle, for any size of company, whether you simply need a single refrigerated van or an entire refrigerated fleet. We have over 25 years experience of working closely with customers, from supermarkets home delivery vehicles, transporting fresh or frozen foods or pharmaceuticals. GAH Refrigeration have the best solution to meet every transport refrigeration requirement.
GAH has become the supplier of choice for many operators who require powerful yet fuel-efficient refrigeration systems. With stringent legislation in place for the delivery of temperature sensitive goods, accurate control of the load space temperature is essential. Our extensive range has evolved from investigating the everyday complications of delivering temperature sensitive goods efficiently in vans, box bodies or multi compartmented multi temperature vehicles.
All GAH transport refrigeration systems are designed and built at our ISO9001 production facility and service centre here in the East of England. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do and our latest systems are not only the lightest in their class but are also highly efficient, reducing our customer’s costs and increasing payload capacity. All of our systems are designed and built to ECWVTA standards and each is designed to blend sympathetically with the aesthetics of the vehicle whilst retaining the functionality and performance essential for such a vital link in the cold chain.
What We Do
From product design and innovation to manufacture, testing and extensive customer support, we work with our customers to deliver pioneering transport refrigeration solutions to meet the ever-changing requirements of their cold chain distribution.
Our in-house development team are dedicated to innovation, seeking new ways to improve the performance and capability of our systems and deliver pioneering refrigeration solutions to meet the ever-changing requirements of the industry.
This dedication to innovation has seen many enhancements including reduced system weights, reduced noise pollution, and the development of electrically driven solutions. Today we continue to work with refrigerant manufacturers to introduce more environmentally friendly refrigerants. We are also introducing new controllers to eliminate most system fuses and relays, ease installation and monitor hours run on components with the new controllers having telematic capabilities built in.
We are hugely proud of our British design and engineering heritage. We manufacture, test, and support our full range of transport refrigeration solutions from our extensive ISO 9001 production facility in the East of England. All GAH transport refrigeration systems blend sympathetically with the aesthetics of the vehicle whilst retaining the functionality and performance essential for such a vital link in the cold chain.
Our latest systems are not only the lightest in class but also highly efficient, reducing our customer’s costs and increasing their payload capacity. We undertake rigorous component inspection and testing as part of our internal quality control systems. We are also VCA audited with all GAH systems designed and built to European Community Whole Vehicle Type Approval (ECWVTA) standards.
We build a wide range of refrigeration systems to suit the needs of commercial vehicles from car-derived vans through to 18 tonne tucks and everything in between. We produce systems for road only use, as well as systems that include mains powered overnight standby refrigeration capability.
New heat-cool systems have also now been developed and introduced, in particular for the transportation of pharmaceutical products. The systems enable vehicles to heat and/or cool two compartments simultaneously, maintaining temperatures from -25°C to 25°C in ambient temperatures as high as 40°C and as low as -20°C. Our experienced team will ensure the most appropriate refrigeration system is recommended to match the specific needs of the customer depending on the type of vehicle, load space, drop frequency and period of operation.
What makes GAH different is that we care! All service support is based around GAH ONE CALL providing customers with a single contact number enabling us to offer the best service available, simply and quickly! GAH systems are installed by an extensive network of qualified installation specialists who work with the vehicle converters to prepare the vehicle to the customers specific requirements.
We provide an extensive range of additional support for all our systems including specialist unit application advice, easy spare parts identification and system history. For fleet customers our new online customer portal allows fleet managers to log on to their own personalised page to simply and efficiently monitor and track the history of their refrigerated vehicles and their projected service dates from a central point, keeping on top of usage, performance and maintenance of each vehicle.
Our Nationwide fleet of service engineers are equipped with the latest GPS fleet management equipment and PDAs enabling fast and accurate data transfer to head office. All appointments and updates are confirmed by email or text to ensure all concerned are fully informed at all stages.
We strive to complete all jobs on the first visit with work being carried out on the customer’s premises. We equip each engineers van with comprehensive stock of refrigerants, specialist service equipment and spare parts which can be tailored to the systems in their area thus maximising up-time and eliminating the need for a vehicle to attend a depot and queue for either routine maintenance or remedial work.
We have a range of maintenance options, designed to suit the diversity of our customers’ applications, but all aim to provide the reassurance needed and help control budgets.
